final: SELECT SUM(color_count) AS total_kept_color_counts, AVG(count_divided_by_sum) AS average_count_divided_by_sum, AVG(excess) AS average_excess FROM (SELECT color_count, CAST(color_count AS REAL) / total_count AS count_divided_by_sum, color_count - average_count AS excess FROM (SELECT color_count, total_count, AVG(color_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM (SELECT product_color, COUNT(*) AS color_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_count FROM Products WHERE product_color IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_color) WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL) WHERE average_count IS NOT NULL AND color_count > average_count)
